# Dynamic Data Table Manager - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Next.js 15 application with TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and Material UI for managing dynamic data tables with CSV import/export, inline editing, and column management.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 15 (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Redux Toolkit + Redux Persist
- Material UI v5
- React Hook Form
- PapaParse (CSV parsing)
- @dnd-kit (drag-and-drop)
- FileSaver.js (CSV export)

## Features
- ✅ Table with sorting, searching, pagination
- ✅ Dynamic column management
- ✅ CSV import/export
- ✅ Inline editing with validation
- ✅ Light/Dark theme toggle
- ✅ Row actions (Edit, Delete)
- ✅ Column reordering
- ✅ Responsive design
